question: True or false: the riddle asking whether God is willing to prevent evil but not able appears in Epicurus's surviving writings?
answer: False. It survives only in Lactantius, a Christian writer around 313, who attributes it to Epicurus while arguing against him; nothing Epicurus left says it, and many scholars doubt it is his. David Hume gave it its famous wording in 1779, in the mouth of a character, Philo.
move: A quotation passed through an opponent's hands deserves a second look.
ask: Which famous quote do I repeat without knowing who really said it?
trap: True, because his name is printed under it everywhere.
reference: Hume, Dialogues Concerning Natural Religion, ed. Kemp Smith, Nelson, 1947, Part 10; Lactantius, On the Anger of God, chapter 13
